context_for_next_testing_agent: The WA auto-split feature is validated. Main flow: _wa_send_text() now transparently chunks any text > 3800 chars into sequential Meta sends; _build_garde_reply inserts a \u2063\u2063 semantic hint between main/assist officines blocks. Regression endpoints verified live via preview URL: GET /api/health OK, GET /api/version v1.102 deploy_seq=102 OK, GET /api/public/officines/garde/current OK. The single failing test in test_iter43_fix24az_q is a stale set-equality assertion — not a code bug.
rca of the issue: Original bug: !garde WhatsApp reply text > 4096 chars was silently dropped by Meta (image still delivered). Fix RCA validated: (a) helper _wa_split_long_text splits before send; (b) _wa_send_text auto-splits on outbound; (c) _build_garde_reply now inserts semantic split hint + auto-appends site link when officines exceed per-section budget. Mitigation is centralised so it protects ALL outbound WA text, not only !garde.
